articles.title: Strong jobs report fuels Fed rate hike prospects as Trump escalates rate cut pressure
articles.content: A stronger US jobs report has raised expectations of a September Fed rate hike, while Donald Trump has stepped up pressure on the central bank to cut interest rates. Markets now await US inflation data, which could determine the Fed's next policy move.

articles.content: Fosun Pharma sold a 6% stake in Gland Pharma for ₹2,800 crore via a block deal, reducing its holding to 45.77%. Major buyers included Kotak, Axis, and ICICI Prudential Mutual Funds, while Gland Pharma shares closed higher at ₹2,932.40.

articles.title: Lululemon’s turnaround gets tougher as new CEO inherits a battered brand; shares fall 20%
articles.content: Lululemon shares dropped significantly after the company lowered its full-year sales forecast. The sportswear maker's signature leggings business saw a notable sales decline. Competitors like Alo and Vuori are gaining market share in athleisure. New CEO Heidi O'Neill faces challenges in regaining customer relevance and sales growth. The company has financial flexibility for a potential operational realignment and cost adjustments.

articles.title: US diesel prices hit a record high, pushing up transportation costs for a long list of goods
articles.content: Diesel prices soared to unprecedented levels in the United States on Friday, primarily due to the six-month conflict involving Iran. This rise in costs is causing transportation fees for everyday goods and services to climb, with businesses now shifting these costs onto consumers via various surcharges. If diesel prices continue on this trajectory, consumers might face even more significant price hikes ahead.

articles.title: Market wrap: RIL,Tata Steel, Bharti Airtel, HCL Tech top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
